test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The volume of a right circular cylinder is 2425.5 cm³ and its base area is 346.5 cm². What is the curved surface area of the cylinder (in cm²)?
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of right circular cylinder = 2425.5 cm³

Base area of cylinder = 346.5 cm²

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = Base area × Height

Base area of cylinder = πr²

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of the base be 'r' and the height of the cylinder be 'h'.

Volume = Base area × Height

2425.5 = 346.5 × h

h = 2425.5 / 346.5

h = 7 cm

Base area = πr²

346.5 = (22/7) × r²

r² = (346.5 × 7) / 22

r² = 2425.5 / 22

r² = 110.25

r = √110.25

r = 10.5 cm

Curved surface area = 2πrh

Curved surface area = 2 × (22/7) × 10.5 × 7

Curved surface area = 2 × 22 × 10.5

Curved surface area = 462 cm²

**∴ The curved surface area of the cylinder is 462 cm².**
